The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 9. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 10.
